newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Transport sees divisions profitable.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Transport sees divisions profitable.

text.p: U.S. Transportation Systems Inc said Monday it sees its tractor-trailer division profitable through the rest of the year and expects a profitable freight services division by September.

Commenting on the company's second quarter results, Michael Margolies, chief executive officer of the company said, "As a result of our comprehensive reorganization and route restructuring, USTI, our new tractor-trailer subsidiary, showed a profit in the second quarter, and we expect this division to remain profitable throughout the year.

"In addition, we have taken measures to bring Armstrong Freight Services back to profitability, by consolidation, computerization, and eliminating unprofitable routes. We expect Armstrong to reach profitability in September of this year," he added.
The company reported second quarter operating net of $0.04 a share or $275,704 compared with $0.22 or 316,969 during the same period a year ago.
